soldier: Head and antennae yellow, nasus brown, the upturned part of the pronotum brownish yellow, thorax, abdomen and legs pale white. Most individuals have almost no hairs on the head and pronotum; a few occasionally bear two to four hairs. Large form: head pear-shaped, narrow in front and broad behind, the lateral margins bulging, the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle; nasus thick and short, not upturned in profile, its tip slightly lower than the posterior margin of the head; mandibles bluntly convex and without a pointed spine. Antennae with 13 segments, the third longer than the second, the second longer than or equal to the fourth, the fourth shortest. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin slightly concave, the posterior margin without a concavity. Small form: colour like that of the large form but slightly paler, hairs on the head and on the dorsum of thorax and abdomen fewer; head pear-shaped, narrow in front, widest near the back of the head, the posterior margin slightly concave; mandibles bluntly convex without a pointed spine; antennae with 12 to 13 segments, the third longer than the second or nearly equal; anterior margin of the pronotum with a small notch in the middle, the posterior margin not concave.
worker: In the worker the apical tooth of the left mandible equals the first marginal tooth, the cutting edge between the two marginal teeth wavy and very inconspicuous.
